final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC in the required format, extracted the message after the service name, and captured the last line of any traceback as the exception or null if none. I also summed repeat counts from the following repeated message lines. Finally, I aggregated counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json in the requested JSON structure.
